summary: @servicetitan/react-hooks preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into an OS temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line, string-array-obfuscated bundle (`_0xNNNN`-style identifiers, `WV8StW` array-rotator, indirect indexing through a large numeric constant array `n7gIxM`) not referenced by the advertised React hooks API and invoked only by the preinstall dropper. Fetching a second language runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated blob at install time is inconsistent with the package's stated purpose (a React hooks library) and is an install-time remote code execution vector: the Bun runtime is used to run code that a Node-based install-time scanner would not naturally trace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
